Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 35 (10d6) fire damage and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

30X6vviajrfNO3KX.name: Rejuvenation
30X6vviajrfNO3KX.html: Rejuvenation. When the revenant dies, roll 1d6. On a 2 to 6, the Revenant is reanimated 1d6 + 3 hours after being slain, restoring the body from any injury and regaining all its hit points. On a 1, or if the body is burned or some other reason prevents its from regenerating, such as a consecration ritual, the Revenant passes to the afterlife and isn’t reanimated.

4CQAKlGdGBWpFg1i.name: Gory Feast
4CQAKlGdGBWpFg1i.html:
Action
Gory Feast. The Striga feasts on a humanoid or beast within 5 feet that is incapacitated, unconscious, or dead for no longer than an hour. The target takes 22 (5d8) slashing damage and 22 (5d8) piercing damage as the vampire tears into it. A creature that is reduced to 0 hit points by this attack is instantly killed and its body is destroyed, torn to pieces by the Striga. The Striga regains an amount of hit points equal to the piercing damage dealt.

QGPEz2lGjc1YpJZk.name: Tome of Decay
QGPEz2lGjc1YpJZk.html:
Wondrous Item (Spellbook), Legendary

This tome is a blasphemous book filled with the most heinous of curses. It was found deep beneath the City of Strings, in forgotten libraries of the Underside, and has been translated from its original, ancient language by Threadmaster Kara Salem of Underside Affairs, for research purposes. Few wizards are allowed to learn the following incantations, for they are dark and profane in nature, and could lead a young and impressionable mind down a dark path. The Order of Spirits keeps track of exactly who borrows this book at any given time.

In addition, when the creature wakes up, it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
